metadata.description: The SkillCDN pack as plugins: skills for an AI agent to do real company work, one plugin per area of work. The same folders are served live through SkillCDN at skillcdn.ai/gh/skillcdn/skills.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Marketing and growth: ads, ad research, promotional video, content, campaigns, posting to social accounts. A short-form AI ad from a reference video and a product link, research in the Meta Ad Library for ad creatives, and approved posts scheduled on an Instagram account in the browser the person signed in.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Original video and audio content: scripted short dramas, series episodes and story-driven shorts. One episode of a vertical short drama on Higgsfield from a premise or a series bible, with native dialogue, verified lines and coded subtitles.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Software development and the tooling an agent works with: code, a codebase's documents, apps, testing, debugging. A skill written from work already done with an agent and a skill verified again from a fresh session; documents turned into a pack an agent searches through SkillCDN, research in such a pack and an answer from it with every citation checked; a new repository set up for a team and its agents with a console project, a studio in which a team keeps producing one kind of thing with its know-how kept as a small pack of its own, and a member's own desk made a private repository; a new web app built and put live on Cloudflare; payments with Stripe from a sandbox to live money; Meta ads from the pixel to running campaigns; the operator's dashboard as a separate Worker behind Cloudflare Access.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design work in the team's design tool or drafted as rendered pages before it: slides and decks, card news, brand assets, icons and store graphics. A document moved into an existing Figma Slides deck as new slides in the deck's own measured design system, audited by numbers and zoomed renders; a first-draft deck as HTML and PDF from an outline, in the organization's own tokens; a product deck that sells a product to its buyers, one message a slide in a scene composed for it; one issue of a market signal magazine as a deck in the brand's own look, every number kept in a ledger and checked against its source; four looks for one design (a page, a deck, a post, a card news format), rendered as HTML and compared on a contact sheet, judged for the AI feel before they are shown; a reference account's card news format measured into a spec from the posts visible without signing in; a card news carousel built from a sourced brief in a spec's own slide types, as HTML rendered to PNG and to mp4 for a slide with a video clip; and several such posts at once, a worker agent per post and a reviewer that made none.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product planning and research: discovery, research synthesis, a sourced brief of a story, concept directions and alternatives, requirements, specifications, roadmaps, prioritization. Which market to enter, every theme judged per country on four questions from official statistics, filings, app stores and the ads running, with a watch list measured again in later rounds; one business idea reviewed in depth before anything is built (the market, the competitors, the supply of what it needs, the legal risks, a pilot); a Korean company's revenue and operating profit found in its DART filings and checked against what it announced; four to six concept directions that get a reference's effect by other means, placed on the axes a concept can move on, judged for the AI feel and compared with a recommendation and a runner-up, then handed to the skill that produces; and this week's candidate stories in the categories an account covers, the user's pick turned into a topic brief with every fact traced to an article sentence and the story's video clips and images collected with their credits, by an account's policy and ledger where it has them; and what is taking off in a market, read from where advertisers put new money in the Meta Ad Library, ranked item by item with a snapshot the next run measures growth against.

plugins.name: operations
plugins.description: Running the company's and its clients' work day to day: the minutes of a meeting sent the same day, status reports, visit logs, handovers, the records an engagement keeps. The minutes of a client meeting as one HTML file and an A4 PDF from the notes a person brings back, split into decisions, questions and answers, items to confirm and actions with what stays internal kept out, rendered in grayscale with the client's logo first, checked against the house style and looked at before delivery.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Text that is the result itself, read or heard as it is: a news script, an article, a report, a briefing. The script of a news anchor report from a sourced topic brief, with the screen planned cut by cut for a video made later: the lead from the viewer's side, each sentence with one job and the form that says how its content is known, checked for its facts, its form and its spoken length, and heard once by a listener who has only the script.
